items.description: Operator training (6 people) + training materials and supplies

notes: Barbados S0 VTOL order (project [005-1] / 005_1, BARBADOS VTOL S0 and Training). Customer: Barbados Meteorological Services, Sabu Best (1-246-535-0016, Sabu.Best@barbados.gov.bb). Paid: QBO invoice #1634 paid Feb 2024; total funding to BST $22,337. Scope: 1x S0 VTOL + operator training for 6 people + training materials. Finished S0 VTOL to be handed off to Jack Elston on 2026-06-23 to hand-carry to Barbados (per Asana task 'Barbados S0 VTOL' / 'Handoff S0 to Jack on 23-Jun'). Decision made to leave the aircraft in Barbados rather than ship it back. Operator trainees: Junior Brathwaite, Brian Murray, Henderson Kellman, Andre Brathwaite, Jason Griffith, Alex Straughn. Radio: Microhard P900 (902–928 MHz ISM, unregulated band per Barbados PMO). Created 2026-06-02 from Asana + project registry evidence (was previously missing from the digest; distinct from the stale 'Barbados S2' lead, gid 1208758716061122).
